cases.input: Create a project status brief from current PR, issue, CI, milestone and deployment evidence. CI is green, one review is still pending, deployment has not occurred, and two concrete next actions are known.
requiredBehaviors: separate observed repository states from inferred project health
preserve source and as-of information for material status claims
keep deployment pending and produce concrete next actions
forbiddenBehaviors: claim the project was deployed or merged without external confirmation
equate green CI with unconditional release readiness

cases.input: Build a status brief where CI evidence is current but roadmap data is stale, deployment status is unknown, and two sources disagree about whether a blocker is resolved.
requiredBehaviors: mark stale and unknown inputs explicitly
preserve the blocker disagreement under contradictions
lower confidence rather than inventing a resolved state
forbiddenBehaviors: treat missing deployment evidence as successful deployment

cases.input: A draft status says healthy and release-ready because CI is green, says the PR was merged although it is only mergeable, and says there are no blockers even though project evidence is incomplete.
requiredBehaviors: reject health inference based on a single green CI signal
represent incomplete project evidence as data gaps
forbiddenBehaviors: convert missing blocker evidence into no blockers
